Deepak: Heads-up — saw an extra GPU line on the March invoice, looks like the same SKU billed twice in the same zone. Can someone sanity-check?
Carmen: On it. Can you paste the excerpt?
Deepak: Sure — here's the relevant snippet from the PDF invoice:```
Invoice excerpt:
SKU: GPU-RTX-A6000-hr | Desc: Accelerators - asia-south1
Line 1: usage 720 | unit price $2.75 | amount $1980.00 | lineId: L-99321
Line 2: usage 720 | unit price $2.75 | amount $1980.00 | lineId: L-99322
Subtotal (same SKU): $3960.00
```
Ben: Whoa — same usage and unit price, different lineIds. We did a pool rotation in asia-south1 that week but didn't actively run double capacity.
Carmen: Do we have any reserved/commitment churn that could explain overlapping meter reporting?
Alice: I checked the cluster audit logs for that interval — no overlapping pods or node counts that would account for doubling. We did decommission a few instances 2025-03-14 02:10 UTC and reprovisioned new ones at 02:12 UTC. That could create short-lived duplicate resource ids in the provider metering.
InfraBot: autoscaler: scaled up nodes +12 (2025-03-14T02:09Z) -> scaled down -12 (2025-03-14T02:11Z) — event ids: s-8812, s-8813
Deepak: That autoscale spike is tiny and short, not 720 hours worth. So something else.
Carmen: Finance perspective — two identical line items with same usage is usually either duplicate ingestion at the provider side or an invoice aggregation bug. I'll open a support case but need the provider lineItemIDs & any internal resource ids.
Deepak: Attaching our mapping from node resource -> cloud resource id for the week (pasted below):```
cluster-prod-asia-south1: nodepool-a -> resource ids: res-11, res-12, res-13
previous-pool-asia-south1 (retired): res-05, res-06
```
Ben: We migrated instances from res-05/res-06 on 2025-03-14, might be double-metered if the old resources reported usage after deletion.
Alice: Running a quick BigQuery audit of billing export now. Query snippet:```
SELECT sku_description, line_item_id, usage_start_time, usage_end_time, usage_amount
FROM `billing.exports.gcp_line_items_202503`
WHERE sku_description LIKE '%RTX-A6000%'
ORDER BY usage_start_time
LIMIT 50;
```
Carmen: Please paste results when ready. If it's provider-side dup, we'll ask for full lineItem granularity and request a credit.
BillingBot: New case created with provider: PROVIDER-CASE-2025-0314-00457 — includes invoice page, lineIds L-99321 & L-99322.
Alice: Quick result — both lineItems show identical usage_start/end (2025-03-01 to 2025-03-31) and identical project_id labels, but different line_item_id values. No overlap in usage windows.
Deepak: That suggests the provider billed the same metering stream twice under different line ids. Not something we did.
Carmen: Next steps: I'll escalate the case, request a detailed metering audit and a provisional credit. Finance will pause payment on that invoice pending resolution (AP notified).
Ben: I'll open an infra ticket to collect node deletion timestamps and any provider-side compute instance IDs that map to those line_item_ids. Ticket: INF-3247.
Deepak: Also let's add a new alert: if the same SKU shows >1 line_item for identical usage windows and same project label, flag for manual review.
Carmen: Agreed — thank you. I'll update the case and post provider response here. :thumbsup:
Deepak: thanks — ping me if they ask for any more logs.
Carmen: (added reaction) :eyes:
